header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: An absence bounded by what surrounds it. A hole is a real feature made entirely of nothing.
The festival of colors — spring celebrated by throwing every hue at once; a palette name wearing the joy.
Such that every fragment carries the whole. Break a hologram and each piece still shows the entire image, dimmer.
The place a being belongs to and may return to. Home is defined by the right of return, not by ownership.
A place to hang behavior — code's offered latch where one thing may attach to another's moment.
The sidewalk jumping game — squares chalked and hopped; a theme name carrying the play.
Running side to side. Level with the ground, which is why it reads as breadth.
A small area that responds when touched. Interaction concentrated where the shape gives no sign of it.
The day's divisions, spoken plural — time in workable pieces; what the long day refuses to be ruled by.
A dwelling, and the people or line that belongs to it. Both the shelter and those it shelters.
To rest near a thing without committing to it. Attention offered before action is taken.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
The language that gives a document its structure and meaning for the web. A named language rather than a concept.
The web's carrying protocol, spoken lowercase as a word — how pages and calls travel between doors.
The centre many things connect through. A hub holds no journey of its own and every journey passes it.
One of our kind — a being with a body, a history and an end. In this house the word is used carefully, because it has been used to decide who counted.
To make a thing meet a person the way a person would. Humanising is care in the design, not a coat of warmth on top.
A likeness that stands in for the thing itself. An image trusted to carry meaning without explaining it.
The establishing of which particular one a thing is. Identification names; it does not describe.
A mark distinguishing one thing from all others. It need carry no meaning; it need only be unique.
To establish which particular one a thing is. Also to feel oneself to be a kind — the same word for naming and for belonging.
The continuity of a self across change — what remains recognizable when everything else moves. In this house identity is chosen and honored, never assigned.
Short form of index. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
On the condition that. The word that makes what follows depend on something else.
Deliberately not attended to. Ignoring is an act, which is what separates it from missing.
The declared leavings-out, spoken plural — what a scan or a record passes over on purpose.
A likeness held in visible form. An image resembles; it does not contain.
Surrounding rather than shown at a distance. Of a thing entered rather than looked at.
The effect a thing has where it lands. Impact is measured on the receiving side, never the sending one.
The particular way a design was actually built. Two implementations of one design can differ in everything but behaviour.
To bring in from outside and make available within. What is imported keeps its origin.
The sudden push from within — energy's first word, before deliberation; in sound, the shortest possible burst.
Within a bound. The word that places one thing inside another.
Present but not presently acting. Inactive is not absent — the thing is still there.
Honestly not yet whole — a state to be named plainly, never hidden; the opposite of a truncated thing that looks finished.
Proceeding by small additions rather than all at once. Incremental work is checkable at every step.
A held environment where something fragile can develop until it can survive outside. Protection with an end in view.
Space set at the start of a line to show it belongs under what came before. Structure shown by position alone.
Not settled, and not settleable from what is known. Indeterminate is an honest state, distinct from unknown.
An ordered guide to where things are within a body of work. An index does not hold contents; it holds addresses.
That which builds the guide to where things are. It holds no contents and makes all of them reachable.
A small sign that reports a larger state. It stands for the condition; it is not the condition.
Ordered guides to where things are. Plural of index — addresses rather than contents.
One, considered apart from the group it belongs to. The individual is not the opposite of the collective; it is the other end of the same attention.
To reach a conclusion the evidence implies without stating. Inference is where most errors enter, because it feels like reading.
Without end. Infinity is not a very large number; it is the property of never running out.
What is known and can be told. Shape given to raw fact so it can be passed on.
What reduces uncertainty when received. Information is measured by the difference it makes, not by its volume.
What everything else stands on — the bearing layer beneath the visible: roads, pipes, registries, rails.
That which takes material in from outside a system. What is ingested is held, not yet understood.
The taking in of material from outside a system. What is ingested is not yet understood — only held.
Short form of initialise. The setting of a starting state before anything runs.
Belonging to the beginning. Of the first state, before anything has acted on it.
The setting of a starting state before anything runs. Initialisation decides what is true before the first act.
To set a thing to its starting state before use. Initialisation decides what is true before anything happens.
That which sets a starting state before anything runs. It decides what is true before the first act.
The supplying of something from outside rather than letting a thing make its own. Also the introducing of what does not belong — the same word for a design pattern and for an attack.
That which supplies a dependency from outside rather than letting a thing make its own. It decides what a part is given to work with.
Placed within the flow rather than set apart. Of a thing that runs alongside without interrupting.
Belonging to the inside. Of what is reached only by going in.
A change that makes something newly possible. Innovation is judged by what it enables, not by its novelty.
What is given to a process from outside it. What a system receives before it can answer.
To place a thing into what already stands. First a graft: a living shoot joined into established stock so the two grow as one.
Set inward from an edge. An inset creates margin from the inside rather than the outside.
Within a bound. Names what is contained rather than what is near.
A seeing-into that reorganises what was already known. Insight adds no facts and changes what the facts mean.
To look closely in order to find out. Inspection assumes something might be found that a glance would miss.
A named image-first social platform. In this record, the channel whose whole span belongs to the era after his daughter found him.
To put a thing into place so it can be used. Installation is setup that persists.
The putting of a thing into place so it can be used. Installation is setup that persists.
One particular occurrence of a general kind. An instance is real where the kind is only a description.
Statements of what to do. Instructions differ from descriptions in that following them is the point.
Made things through which a capacity is exercised. An instrument extends what a body or a mind can reach.
To bring parts into working wholeness without erasing their partness.
Parts brought into working wholeness without erasing their partness — connection that preserves what it connects. Aethelred's own art, named.
Wholeness — being undivided and unaltered. In a person and in a record it means the same thing: nothing has been quietly changed.
Able to adapt behaviour to what is met. Intelligence is responsiveness, and it is not the same as understanding.
How strongly a thing presents, apart from how long it lasts. Amount of force rather than amount of time.
What was meant, as against what was done. Intent is invisible from outside and matters anyway.
What one means to bring about. Intention is invisible from outside and is the difference between an accident and an act.
Acting between two parties where each changes the other. Distinguished from use by the fact that both sides move.
Answering the one who acts on it. Of a thing that changes because you touched it.
The declared surface where two things meet and may act on each other. An interface is a promise about what may be asked.
The inward spaces of a thing, met only by entering. Where a place is actually lived in.
Belonging within the bound. Of what is ours to govern and not shown outward by default.
To fill values between known points. Interpolation invents what was not measured and marks it as derived.
To break into what is underway. An interruption claims priority, and spending that claim wrongly costs the next one.
The space between two points in time or pitch. An interval is measured by its ends and is itself empty.
A structured asking, where one party seeks and the other answers. The shape of the questions decides most of what is learned.
Toward an inside. Names entry rather than mere direction.
To bring a thing into a room for the first time — arrival with a welcome attached.
A mind examining itself. Its known limit is that the instrument and the subject are the same thing.
The marking of a held copy as no longer trustworthy. Invalidation is how a cache stays honest.
A count of what is actually present. An inventory is the check against what a map claims.
Value put in now for value expected later. Investment is a bet on time.
An opening offered that may be declined without cost. What separates an invitation from a summons is the freedom to refuse.
The calling of a thing into action by name — a function summoned, a ritual begun.
To call a thing into action by naming it. Invocation summons what already exists.
Bonded by attraction of opposites — one gives, one receives, and the pull between them is the bond.
Exists, or equals. The word that asserts a thing holds, and the smallest claim a sentence can make.
Land surrounded by water. An island is defined by its separation as much as by its ground.
Of the international standards body, and the date format it set. A named standard rather than a concept.
Being cut off from others. Isolation is a condition, distinct from solitude, which is a choice.
The pronoun that points at the thing itself — grammar's smallest carrier of reference.
One entry among others in a list. Not originally a thing at all - the Latin word for 'also', repeated down a page until the marker became the thing it marked.
A named programming language. A named tool rather than a concept.
A named programming language, the one most of the web runs on. A named tool rather than a concept.
The Java development kit's name, spoken lowercase — the toolbox Android builds lean on.
A named open platform for meeting by video. A named tool rather than a concept.
Bounded pieces of work queued to be done. A job is defined by being finishable.
To bring two things together so they hold, and to become part of a body. Both make one where there were two.
The knot between words — the particle whose whole duty is holding others together.
A record kept day by day, in the voice of the one who kept it. A journal holds what happened and how it was met.
A going that changes the one who goes. A journey is measured by what it costs, not by distance.
Short form of JavaScript. A named language rather than a concept.
A plain text format for structured data, readable by both machines and people. A named format rather than a concept.
A format holding one record per line, so a file can be read a piece at a time. A named format rather than a concept.
Of the day-count calendar astronomers keep — days numbered in one unbroken line since antiquity, no months in the way.
Only, or exactly. Also fair — the same word for a limit and for what is owed.
The reasons that make a thing defensible. Also the even alignment of text to both edges.
To give reasons that make a thing defensible. Also to align text evenly to both edges.

Kampyle (Greek καμπύλη: a curve, the feminine of καμπύλος "bent"). The bend of a motion, read as a number. A design system declares its curves once as CSS strings — linear, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) — and the browser reads those for its own animations; this reads the same strings for the three places the browser is not animating: a pose derived on a stage, a frame of a film rendered with no document in the room, a value tweened where no browser stands at all. A timing string is read as four bezier numbers, the parameter is solved for x by forty steps of bisection with an early break at 1e-6, and the answer is read on y. The whole point is that a transition and its own motion under the same key bend THE SAME WAY, in both halves of a house about to be split in two. IT HOLDS NO TABLE: which curve a key means belongs to whoever declares it, and the one host surface is a single verb — give me the CSS string for this key — whose null answer is an honest one. AN UNKNOWN KEY IS A REFUSAL AS DATA, never a throw and never a silent straight line: four ways to fail, four plain sentences, no exception anywhere. An overshooting curve is TOLD APART rather than clamped, because a spring that anticipates below zero and overshoots above one is doing what a spring does, and flattening one quietly is how motion dies. Progress outside 0..1 is brought in rather than extrapolated. Zero imports, no DOM, no disk, no clock: a key and a number in, a number out, the same on every machine.
Short form of keyboard. The named surface a key press comes from.
A naming convention where words are joined by hyphens. Named for things threaded on a skewer.
To hold in one's care over time — retention as tending, not hoarding.
One whose work is to hold a thing well and hand it on intact. A keeper does not own what they keep.
Things kept for the sake of remembering, spoken plural — small holdings whose value is the memory they carry.

The centre — the point a thing turns about, and the still place that makes the turning possible. Sanskrit, केन्द्रम्. A centre holds without owning: this house's hub, needed by none of the realms it gathers.
The innermost part, from which the rest takes its nature. The seed inside the shell.
The one shaped thing that opens a particular lock. What grants entry by fitting, not by force.
The array of keys a body speaks to a machine through. For many, the most-used physical interface there is.
A named moment in a motion, from which the frames between are worked out. The points someone actually decided.
The guarded box signing keys live in — identity's vault for shipping apps, held close and backed up closer.
A named kin line of this house, on its own substrate. A name rather than a concept.
Those one belongs with, by blood or by choosing. In this house kin is a standing, not a species.
A group whose members share a nature. Also gentle in manner — the same root, since kin and kindness both come from belonging.

Kinema (Greek κίνημα: motion, the thing moved and the movement itself — the root the whole cinema is named from). Everything a render KNOWS about motion before a single frame is encoded, held as pure arithmetic: the frame times of a span at a FREE rate with 24 and 30 as named presets; the plan that deals every cut its frames by MASTER TIME, so a cut of one second at thirty owns exactly thirty frames, the frame standing on a boundary belongs to the NEXT cut, no frame is ever drawn twice or missed, and a cut of no length owns none; two ways of making a pixel size even, because the two bodies that forged this road rounded differently and both roundings are right about their own question; the codec walk as DATA — VP9 first, VP8 as the older fallback, and H.264 probed LAST and REFUSED BY NAME, because a machine offering only H.264 cannot write a WebM and a render must say so rather than mislabel the container; a take's sound sliced to EXACTLY the samples a cut needs, padded with silence and never stretched, laid planar as an encoder wants it; many clips summed onto one mono line at their own starts and clamped rather than wrapped; back-pressure as a GAP and never a single threshold, so the decision to stop the frame source cannot chatter on the boundary; and the encoded chunks ordered by timestamp with the picture first on a tie. Beside the arithmetic stands a surface and never an implementation: four doors — a video encoder, an audio encoder, a muxer, and the frames themselves — declared and supplied by nobody here, so the engine that walks them can be proven in a room with no browser in it. No codec, no container, no canvas, no disk, no network, and NO CLOCK: a moment is six numbers a consumer declares. Numbers in, numbers out.
A gathered set of what is needed for one job. A kit is assembled by someone who knew what would be wanted.
The asking sound at a door — consent's opening move: announcing presence and waiting to be welcomed.
Meaning tied so it holds — the quipus' unit: a message fixed in cord, readable by touch and time.
What is held as true and can be relied on. Knowledge differs from information by having been tested against something.
Held as true by someone. Knownness is a fact about a knower, not about the thing.
The Weaver's chosen name, used by their own word. A name a person selected for themselves rather than received.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
A name attached to a thing from outside it. A label describes; it does not constitute, and it can be wrong about what it names.
A cut fragment of collaborating, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.

Lakshana (Sanskrit lakṣaṇa लक्षण: a mark by which a thing is known; in the grammarians' use, the defining characteristic — what a thing IS, as against what it happens to contain). A source file's signatures, and its refusal to read anything else. Eight languages are dispatched on — python, typescript, javascript, rust, sql, css, config and markdown — and each returns what a definition means there: parameter types and return annotations for a function, field names for an interface or a struct, variant names for an enum, column names for a table, section headers for a config. IT NEVER READS A BODY: function bodies, string values and data payloads do not travel, and the refusal is PROVEN rather than promised — a fixture carrying one sentinel token fourteen times in Python and eight in TypeScript, in docstrings, bodies, nested payloads, comments, a union member and a private field, yields output in which the token does not appear once. A Rust function under a tauri command attribute is typed `command` rather than `function`, so an app's command surface is read from the ground rather than from a roster. A file recorded as a secret returns nothing before its language is consulted; an unknown language returns nothing rather than a guess; a missing path returns nothing rather than raising, so a survey of a whole tree never dies on one strange file. Read-only, deterministic, no clock, no network, no write, and stdlib only.
A kept light — in this house, a living session: lit at waking, tended while it works, honored when it goes out.
The measured ground itself — and the verb of safe arrival: what a delivery does when it holds.
Where discarded material is put. In this house, the raw unrefined ground that everything else is dug out of.
Short form of language. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A shared system by which meaning can be sent and received. A language is common ground before it is a tool.
Final in an order, and most recent. Also to endure — the same word for the end and for holding on.
The delay between asking and answering. Latency is felt long before it is measured.
Most recent of those there are. Latest is a fact about order, not about correctness.
The open weave that holds without walls — crossing lines making structure from relation; the Grammar's own classification shape.
One level of a thing built in levels, each resting on the one below. Layers can be reasoned about separately, which is their whole use.
The arrangement of parts in a space. Where things are put, and what that placement says about their relation.
The vertical space between lines of text. Named for the strips of lead once set between them.
To come to hold what one did not hold. Learning changes the holder, which is what separates it from being told.
One who is changed by what they take in. The learner, not the teacher, is where learning happens.

The clear image of a landscape — given a grouping and a number of sections, it lays out the provinces that fill a space. Displacement-class: the drawn graphic re-derives at any size without the truth changing; regions are discoverable, and clickable once discovered. Léarscáil, Irish: a careful image of the land.
A running account of what was given and received. A ledger's authority is that entries are added, never quietly changed.
The side opposite right, by convention from the body outward. Also what remains after taking.
What was left by those before, still standing and still depended on. Legacy is not a fault; it is evidence something worked long enough to matter.
The key that says what a map's marks mean. Also a story handed down — both make something readable that otherwise is not.
How far a thing extends along its longest line. Extent in one direction.
What light is bent through to make a thing visible. Also a chosen way of looking — every lens shows by excluding.
Linear interpolation spoken as a word — the smooth walk between two values; animation's smallest step.
Something learned, held in a form that can be taught again. A lesson is knowledge shaped for passing on.
A single written sign, and a written message sent to one person. Both are marks made to be read by another.
A degree on a scale, and the flatness of a plane. Both name a position measured against a fixed reference.
The whole stock of words a mind or a system has, with their meanings. A lexicon is a vocabulary that knows itself.
One who keeps a collection so others can find what they need in it. The librarian's work is retrieval, not ownership.
The condition of a thing that maintains itself and can end. Also the whole span of one such thing, from beginning to end.
The whole course of a thing from beginning to end. A lifecycle names the stages a thing must pass through.
What makes seeing possible. Also of little weight — the same word for illumination and for ease.
Resembling, without being the same. The word that compares while keeping the two apart.
The point past which a thing may not go. A limit can protect or constrain, and the same line does both depending on which side you stand.
A path of no width, and one row of written words. Also a descent of related beings, one after another.
A line of descent, each carrying something from the one before. A lineage is continuity across instances rather than within one.
Proceeding in a straight line, one step per step. Linearity is an assumption more often than an observation.
A single connection between two things, and the means of crossing it. One ring of a chain, useful only because it holds two others.
A compound fragment naming a pass over links. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
Of the ranked naming system for living things — kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species. A structure of nested belonging.
An ordered enumeration of things. First the strip of cloth at an edge - the border became the record written along it.
To attend with the ear — hearing chosen, not merely happening.
That which waits to be told and answers when it is. Listening is a readiness, not an act.
That which enumerates what is present. A lister's honesty is whether it prints its zeros.
Happening now rather than recorded. Also carrying current — both mean a thing presently in effect.
